description: The user's Xenmark notification inbox, newest first: new comments, replies, mentions and status changes on drawings the user is part of. Each row has actor_name, project_name, drawing_number, revision_label, comment_number, title, preview, mention_labels, old_status/new_status (status changes), read, created_at and a web_url deep link into Xenmark. Use web_url for links - never build Xenmark URLs.
name: xenmark_recent_activity
